name: General Quality Rubric
description: Standard rubric for evaluating prompt quality across all categories.

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.description: Is the prompt clear and easy to understand?

criteria.name: specificity
criteria.description: Does the prompt provide enough specific detail to get a useful response?

criteria.name: context
criteria.description: Does the prompt include relevant background context?

criteria.name: grammar
criteria.description: Is the prompt grammatically correct and well-structured?

criteria.name: completeness
criteria.description: Does the prompt cover all necessary aspects of the task?

criteria.name: creativity
criteria.description: Does the prompt encourage creative and useful output?
